standard_prerequisites.name: Density after etale cover
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Properties of Spaces, lemma etale-image-open (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Images of etale morphisms are open.

core_obligations: Given a nonempty open of X, take a point of it of finite type over the base.
The lifting lemma gives a closed point x' of finite type with x' -> x, hence inside the open.
Conclude closed points of finite type meet every nonempty open, i.e. are dense.
proof_roadmap: Point of finite type; lifting; density conclusion.
difficulty_reason: A three-step density argument on the carded lifting lemma.
